decision.title: Schematron: the function library's prefixes, the document of each finding, real rule sets read with warnings (packet )

body.p: , after , , , and the owner's three requests of 2026-10-29 (the third his choice of option a on 's Proposed entry, which this record replaces). Sources: ISO/IEC 19757-3:2025 by clause; nothing of its text copied.

item.p: Whom it serves: the user of sxml validate --schematron and the embedder who run real rule sets (EN 16931, XRechnung) from their sources, and the author of a pattern with documents. Pays: a field of the report, one internal walk of the stylesheet AST's variable references per compile that has pattern variables, one warning path in the reader, a JSON member, the book's pages.

1. Prefixes. 5.4.10 says the prefixes of query expressions are defined by ns; every binding annex adds that all namespaces, prefixes, functions and operators its functions specification defines shall be available (Annexes H, I, J, K, L; M and N for the XQuery bindings sxml refuses; Annex C, XPath 1.0, defines none, and sxml reads xslt and no binding as 4.0, B). Read together: xs, fn, math, , and err resolve without ns in every query expression, and in the XSLT declarations the xslt bindings read, for a prefix they leave unbound; an sch:ns may bind any of them and then wins; xml is XPath's own; every other prefix still needs sch:ns; SVRL lists the sch:ns bindings only. 's wording is amended. The 7.30 suite's rules-predeclared-xs-prefix becomes normative (no findings) and five cases join schema-structure (ns-predeclared-*, ns-undeclared-other-prefix).

2. The document of a finding. A finding of a pattern with documents (5.4.12) was printed with the validated file's name and the other document's lines, and JSON did not say which document. sxml_schematron_report gains (additive, at its end): the document URI of the tree the subject node is in, so a subordinate document's, one fn:doc read, else the validated document's; node_location is that document's. The command shows it where it showed FILE, by its path from the working directory, and JSON findings gain document; the host shim and the package give document. SVRL already said it as Annex D asks: each fired-rule of such a pattern carries the subordinate document's URI (Table D.1, note c), and the findings follow their fired rule.

3. Real rule sets read with warnings (option a). Three deviations are accepted by default, each occurrence a report with the code schematron:compatibility through the compile report sink, naming the clause: a parameter named twice in one pattern instance (the first value is used, as SchXslt does; 5.4.11, Annex B); a pattern's let read by another pattern, a variable outside patterns or an XSLT declaration (3.23 scopes it to its pattern; a global of the written name refers to the first compiled pattern's let; references are found in the stylesheet AST, XSLT's scoping and the expression's own bindings respected); a rule's let after its assertions (Annex A; evaluated before them as every rule let is). A warning is not counted as an error, never fills the error record, and the null sink drops it; the command prints warning: before the code, keeps the exit status and lists them in schematron.warnings of its JSON; the package has Schematron.warnings. The undeclared xs in XRechnung's xsl:function is no deviation after 1. Anything else stays an error (a let after a rule in a pattern, a parameter twice in a schema, ...). The suite's abstract-param-duplicate, let-pattern-not-visible-elsewhere and the new let-after-assertion are deviations with this record's reason (they are errors by the standard).
Not done: no option to make the warnings errors (nothing asked for one); a pattern's let defined only in a pattern the phase does not compile is not shared (XPST0008 as before).

Evidence: suite 520 cases, pass 467, fail 0, deviations 6 (3 of , 3 of this record), implementation-defined 42, not applicable 5; EN 16931 UBL 1,133 of 1,133 and CII 9 of 9 checks from the sources (ctest schematron/en16931-ubl, -cii); XRechnung UBL and CII compile from the unpatched sources and run their 354 instances (schematron/xrechnung-*); the differential against SchXslt 1.10.1 on the unpatched sources identical: EN 16931 UBL 255 instances (274 findings, 23,099 fired rules), CII 128, XRechnung UBL 226, CII 128 (ctest schematron/differential-* with SXML_SCHEMATRON_DIFFERENTIAL, about ten minutes or more). Unit tests reports_name_their_document, compatibility_warnings; CLI tests for documents and warnings, text and JSON; debug-gcc and release. The book's Schematron chapters match (rules: the prefixes; documents: a pattern over vane-api.xsd; reports: Warnings with older.sch, written for the book) and it builds. No shared XSLT file changed. The package's additions typecheck; sxml.wasm was not built (no WASI SDK here).
